## Delivery checklist
- [ ] Conventional Commit subject and focused diff
- [ ] Unit/API tests added or updated; `make test` passes
- [ ] `make lint` and `make validate` pass
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or production values committed
- [ ] Container / Kubernetes / Terraform impact documented
- [ ] Rollback plan stated for production-affecting changes
- [ ] Observability: metrics, logs, alerts, or dashboards updated if needed
- [ ] Lab manual source regenerated if the experiment procedure changed
